那前台妹子鄙夷了一下。
不过，她心中也有些奇怪。
看着四周脏兮兮的街道，还有臭气熏天的水沟，她不知道叶总裁怎么安排人住在这里？
如果只是无关紧要的小员工，叶总裁当然不会亲自指示自己带他来这里。但是，如果是重要的人，怎么安排在这里？
想不通啊！
算了，想不通就不想了。
那妹子看了一下时间，差不多该走了，就把一个袋子全部给了杨云帆道：“这是钥匙，这是地址，现在下班时间到了，我回家了。不送你上去了！明天，应该会有专门的人来找你的。”
说完，她就走了，留下杨云帆一个人。
眼下，天色已黑，杨云帆又没地方可去。摸了摸口袋里仅有的五百块钱，那薄薄的五张纸……
“也罢，有个免费地方住，先讲究着对付着。等老子赚到钱了，就去住别墅！”杨云帆心里狠狠发誓一番，背起旅行包，大大方方的走进了前方的垃圾街。
可走了一半路，他的肚子就发出“咕噜”一声叫，显然是饿了。
杨云帆有些无奈。
自从开始修炼，他的饭量足足比常人大三倍。他感觉自己肚子像是一个无底洞，吃什么都吃不饱。不过，他的精力也变得极为旺盛，一天只需要睡两个小时就比得上以前睡十个小时。
“算了，想再多也没用。肚子饿了，先去吃一顿。”
杨云帆所住的地方是湘潭市的郊区，非常偏僻。这个地方，鱼龙混杂，什么人都有。经常会发生打架，抢劫等犯罪事件。不过，现在还是白天，情况相对好一点。
杨云帆拐个弯，就找到了一家餐馆。
那店的老板是一个三十来岁的女子，长得很秀气，笑起来有两个酒窝，很有亲切感。只是起早摸黑的工作，让她脸上露出不少风霜。
现在是下午五点半出头，正是吃晚餐的时候，那女子看到杨云帆过来，冲他一笑道，“小伙子，吃点什么？我们家的水煮肥牛相当好吃，要不要来一份？”
“来三份吧。”杨云帆点了点头。他也知道自己吃得有点多，所以直接点了三份。

“好的，你稍等。马上来。”那女子对他微微一笑，便又转头去应付其他人了。
杨云帆坐下之后，那女老板很快就把他的东西送上来了，笑道：“慢慢吃啊。”
杨云帆心里想着事，点了一下头，就开始慢条斯理的吃起了东西。
可过了没多久，外面忽然发出一阵劈哩啪啦的吵闹，早餐店里面的人，一看情形不对，全都跑出去了。只剩下杨云帆一个人。
就在这时候，杨云帆看到几个流里流气的身影出现在店里，冷冷瞥了杨云帆一眼，看他不过是个瘦弱的年轻人，就懒得理他。转头看向那老板。
“说吧，你老公的赌债，你准备什么时候还啊？你老公大概欠了十五万，我看你这个店的店面还不错。我做主，卖了，替你老公还债吧。”
那些人中，一个脸上带刀疤的男子凑了一口烟，慢慢吐出之后，不阴不阳的道。
那女老板停下手上的动作，冷冷看了他一眼，道：“谁借你的钱，你跟谁去要！我这个店不卖！我卖了，谁养活我们母女？你一个大老爷们，有本事去把那个王八蛋找出来啊，为难我们孤儿寡母的，算什么本事？”
“呵……林桂华，你这样说，看来我们是没得谈了。本来我不想这么缺德的，是你逼我的。”
那刀疤脸冷笑一声，深吸一口，然后慢慢掐灭烟头，转过身去，对着后面一个小弟喊了一句：“虎子，把人带过来！让她看一看。”
“好嘞，刀疤哥。”
一个虎背熊腰的大汉，立马跑出去，然后从一辆货车里面拉出一个穿着校服的小女孩。
“小娟！”
林桂华一看到小女孩，整个人都陷入了疯狂。
这个女孩正是她唯一的女儿。
“林桂华，如果你不想你女儿出什么事的话，就把钱还了吧。说实话，刀疤哥我不是第一天出来混。我自问不是什么好人。可一般情况下，我也不干这些缺德事。我们6只是替人要债。软的不行，我也只能来硬的。”
眼看自己的女儿被人抓在手里，林桂华整个人都失去了支撑，瘫软在地上。
她牙关紧咬，可看着女儿在对方手里挣扎的模样，她心里如同刀绞。可却没有什么其他办法。

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author’s quick channel for copyright complaints. “You have a place to live for free, but you still pick and choose?”
The girl at the front desk looked down upon her.
However, there was something strange in her heart.
Looking at the dirty streets and smelly ditches around her, she wondered how President Ye could arrange for people to live here?
If it was just an insignificant employee, President Ye would certainly not personally instruct him to bring him here. However, if it is an important person, how should it be arranged here?
I can’t figure it out!
Forget it, don’t think about it if you can’t figure it out.
The girl looked at the time and saw that it was almost time to leave, so she gave a bag to Yang Yunfan and said, "This is the key, and this is the address. Now it's time to get off work. I'm going home. I won't send you up! Tomorrow, there should be a special person looking for you."
After saying that, she left, leaving Yang Yunfan alone.
It was now dark, and Yang Yunfan had nowhere to go. I touched the only five hundred dollars in my pocket, and those five thin pieces of paper...
"Forget it, there is a free place to live. Let's deal with it carefully first. When I make money, I will live in a villa!" Yang Yunfan swore in his heart, picked up his travel bag, and walked into the garbage street in front of him.
But halfway through the walk, his stomach growled, obviously he was hungry.
Yang Yunfan was a little helpless.
Since he started practicing, his appetite has been three times larger than that of ordinary people. He felt like his stomach was like a bottomless pit and he couldn't get enough from anything he ate. However, his energy has also become extremely high, and he only needs to sleep for two hours a day instead of ten hours before.
"Forget it, it's useless to think about it any more. I'm hungry, let's go have a meal first."
Yang Yunfan lives in the suburbs of Xiangtan City, which is very remote. This place is a mixed bag of fish and dragons, and everyone is there. Fights, robberies and other crimes often occur. However, it is still daytime and the situation is relatively better.
Yang Yunfan turned a corner and found a restaurant.
The owner of the shop is a woman in her thirties. She is very delicate, has two dimples when she smiles, and is very friendly. It's just that the work of getting up early and working in the dark left a lot of wind and frost on her face.
It was early five-thirty in the afternoon, and it was time for dinner. When the woman saw Yang Yunfan coming, she smiled at him and said, "Young man, what do you want to eat? Our boiled fat beef is quite delicious. Do you want some?"
"Let's have three portions." Yang Yunfan nodded. He also knew that he had eaten a bit too much, so he ordered three portions.
"Okay, wait a moment. Come right away." The woman smiled at him, then turned to deal with the others.
After Yang Yunfan sat down, the female boss quickly brought his things to him and said with a smile: "Eat slowly."
Yang Yunfan was thinking about something, nodded, and began to eat slowly.
But not long after, there was a sudden crackling noise outside, and everyone in the breakfast shop ran out when they saw something was wrong. Yang Yunfan was the only one left.
At this moment, Yang Yunfan saw a few arrogant figures appearing in the store. He glanced at Yang Yunfan coldly and saw that he was just a thin young man, so he didn't bother to pay attention to him. Turning to look at the boss.
"Tell me, when are you going to pay off your husband's gambling debt? Your husband owes about 150,000, and I think your store is pretty good. I'll make the decision, sell it, and pay off the debt for your husband."
Among those people, a man with a scar on his face took a puff of cigarette, slowly exhaled it, and said in a neutral tone.
The female boss stopped what she was doing, glanced at him coldly, and said: "Whoever lends you money is the one you ask for! I don't sell in this store! If I sell it, who will support our mother and daughter? You, a big man, have the ability to find that bastard, who is making things difficult for us orphans and widowed mothers, forget itWhat ability? "
"Ha...Lin Guihua, if you say this, it seems that we have nothing to talk about. I didn't want to be so immoral, but you forced me to do so. "
The scarred face sneered, took a deep breath, then slowly put out the cigarette butt, turned around, and shouted to a boy behind him: "Hu Zi, bring this person over here! Let her take a look. "
"Okay, Brother Scar. "
A burly man with a heavy back and a heavy waist ran out immediately, and then pulled out a little girl in school uniform from a truck.
“Xiaojuan! "
When Lin Guihua saw the little girl, he went crazy.
This girl is her only daughter.
"Lin Guihua, if you don't want anything to happen to your daughter, just pay back the money. To be honest, Brother Scar is not my first day out here. I ask myself that I am not a good person. But under normal circumstances, I don't do these immoral things. We 6 are just collecting debts for others. Soft ones are not enough, so I can only use hard ones. "
Seeing his daughter being caught in someone's hands, Lin Guihua lost all support and collapsed on the ground.
She gritted her teeth, but seeing her daughter struggling in the other's hands, her heart felt like a knife. But there is no other way.
